_comment: The record the game plays, in the order it should play.
Every track here is played start to finish, crossfading into the next, and
the list loops when it reaches the end. The game does NOT switch songs to
match what's happening on screen — a bong phases whatever is playing and
drowning muffles it, but the album runs straight through underneath.
This file is the game's ONLY public audio surface. S'music's real library sits
behind get_library(band, password), and the game is a public page — shipping
that password in the source would hand anyone who views it the keys to the
unreleased mixes. So instead: you list here, by hand, the tracks you're happy
for the whole internet to hear. Nothing else is reachable from the game.
'src' is the object path inside the public 'tracks' bucket in Supabase — the
same path S'music stores, with or without the leading 'tracks/'. Upload a mix
through S'music as normal, then paste its path here. To find the paths for
your other songs, open your S'music page, sign in, and run this in the
browser console:
(await libRpc('get_library', {})).songs.flatMap(s =>
s.versions.map(v => ({ title: s.title, version: v.name, src: v.src })))
Order is the running order. Add, remove or reorder freely — nothing else in
the game needs changing, and a single track is a complete soundtrack.
The three below are the newest mix of each song as of 11 Aug 2026. Swapping
one for a different version is a one-line edit: change 'src' to that
version's path and 'version' to whatever you want the title card to read.
'treasure' names which track the chest gives away. It has to match a title
in the list; if it doesn't, the chest falls back to track one.
